responsibility: Implements LONGREAL formatting into DynamicStrings using ldtoa output plus gm2 string-manipulation helpers. It owns the logic for significant-figure rounding, decimal-point insertion, engineering exponent normalization, fixed-point formatting, sign handling, and exponent suffix generation, producing reusable formatted strings that feed LongConv length queries and the LongIO/LongStr output layers.
same_name_distinction: This is the LONGREAL formatting implementation for the ConvStringLong interface: unlike ConvStringLong.def, it performs the real work of building floating, engineering, and fixed-point strings, using ldtoa for long-real conversion.
